cases.name: promise-abort-preexisting
cases.code: nodeRepl.write(JSON.stringify(await(async()=>{const err=e=>({name:e.name,message:e.message,code:e.code??null,...(e.cause!==undefined?{cause:e.cause}:{})});const p=await import('node:timers/promises');const ac=new AbortController();const reason={owned:1};ac.abort(reason);const out=[];for(const call of [()=>p.setTimeout(3,7,{signal:ac.signal}),()=>p.setImmediate(7,{signal:ac.signal}),()=>p.setInterval(3,7,{signal:ac.signal}).next()])try{await call()}catch(e){out.push([e.name,e.code,e.message,e.cause===reason])}return out;})()));
